summary: Three targeted changes: (1) replace inline CreateForm with a '+' button that routes to /series/new, handled by SeriesDetailPage in creation mode; (2) fix list row CSS to use theme tokens; (3) add POST /api/series/by-name/{label_name}/values for Chronos name-based external writes.

classification.why_application: All three changes are application-specific: the UX creation flow, the list row styling matching the app's design system, and the Chronos endpoint which resolves a series by its human-readable domain name.
non_goals: Changes to the batch read endpoint
Duplicate-name resolution for the by-name endpoint (returns 404 if not found)

consumes: LabelEngine Postgres shared schema: labels.labels table (case-insensitive name lookup for by-name endpoint)
provides: POST /api/series/by-name/{label_name}/values — write measurements by human-readable series name (Chronos integration)
invariants: All Sprint01 invariants remain in force
Name lookup for by-name endpoint is case-insensitive exact match against labels.labels.name
If label_name matches no series in numeric_series.series, endpoint returns 404 SERIES_NOT_FOUND
by-name endpoint reuses ExternalWriteRequest model and identical insert logic as the existing /values endpoint
failure_modes: SERIES_NOT_FOUND: label_name does not match any series (404)
INVALID_VALUE: measurement value is not a finite number (422)
INVALID_TIMESTAMP: recorded_at cannot be parsed as ISO-8601 (422)

exposed_surfaces.name: POST /api/series/by-name/{label_name}/values
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Allows Chronos to append measurements using the human-readable series name. Resolves the name to a label_id via a case-insensitive exact match on labels.labels.name joined with numeric_series.series. On match: validates and inserts entries, returns {inserted: N}. On no match: 404 SERIES_NOT_FOUND.

internal_flow.name: by_name_write
internal_flow.description: Path param label_name is URL-decoded. Backend executes: SELECT s.label_id FROM numeric_series.series s JOIN labels.labels l ON l.id = s.label_id WHERE lower(l.name) = lower(:label_name). If no row returned, 404 SERIES_NOT_FOUND. If found, validate each entry (value finite, recorded_at ISO-8601). Insert all entries into numeric_series.measurements using the resolved label_id. Return {inserted: N}.

internal_flow.name: ux_creation_flow
internal_flow.description: SeriesListPage: remove CreateForm and its import. Add a '+' button in the page header (top-right). Button click: navigate('/series/new'). SeriesDetailPage: on mount, if label_id === 'new', render creation mode (text input for series name, 'Create' button, 'Back' button, no measurements table, no delete button). On submit: POST /api/series with {label_name}. On success: navigate('/series/' + response.label_id). On error: show inline error.

internal_flow.name: list_row_styling
internal_flow.description: In SeriesListPage, replace hardcoded dark colors with CSS theme tokens: background → var(--md-sys-color-surface), border → 1px solid var(--md-sys-color-outline-variant), border-radius → 8px, label name → color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface) + fontWeight 500, latest value → color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant), empty sparkline dash → color: var(--md-sys-color-on-surface-variant). Sparkline stroke keeps #7c6af5.
outputs: updated inline styles on list row divs

internal_required.role: labels.labels schema read for name resolution

forbidden: Any Sprint01 forbidden items remain in force
Do not call LabelEngine HTTP API for the by-name lookup — resolve directly via the shared Postgres schema labels.labels

persistence.note: No schema changes in this sprint. All persistence is unchanged from Sprint01.

risks.risk: Route conflict: /api/series/by-name/{label_name}/values and /api/series/{label_id}/values share the /api/series/ prefix. FastAPI evaluates routes in registration order.
risks.impact: If by-name route is registered after the label_id route, a literal label_name value of 'by-name' could shadow. Mitigation: register POST /api/series/by-name/{label_name}/values before POST /api/series/{label_id}/values in batch.py, or rely on the distinct path segment 'by-name' being a fixed string that FastAPI will prefer over a dynamic segment when declared first.
